name: Frequency Regularization for Densification
aliases: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Progressive Frequency Regularization
definition: A technique that addresses the over-reconstruction issue of 3D Gaussian splatting by regularizing frequency signals in the Fourier space, specifically by minimizing the discrepancy between the frequency spectrum of the rendered image and the ground truth.
summary: Frequency Regularization for Densification improves 3D Gaussian Splatting by minimizing Fourier space discrepancies to guide coarse-to-fine densification, addressing the over-reconstruction blur caused by standard spatial loss methods.
